summary: Hunter collapsed on Lincoln Creek Road about 2.7 miles past Grizzly Reservoir while the hunter's guide was administering CPR; the first rescue team found no signs of life and the patient was deceased.
location: Lincoln Creek Road, ~2.7 mi past Grizzly Reservoir
notes: Notification via Garmin inReach ~1:47 PM; teams coordinated with Coroner on scene; all teams out by 7:26 PM. Pitkin County Sheriff's Office, Aspen Ambulance District, Aspen Fire Protection District, CareFlight of the Rockies, Pitkin County Coroner involved.
